mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PUBLIC.CANDYBAR_INGREDIENT (CANDYBAR_ID, INGREDIENTS_ID) VALUES (#{candybarId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{ingredientsId, jdbcType=INTEGER});
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS id, i.name AS name FROM PUBLIC.CANDYBAR AS c LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.CANDYBAR_INGREDIENT AS ci ON c.id = ci.CANDYBAR_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.INGREDIENT AS i ON i.id = ci.INGREDIENTS_ID WHERE 1=1 AND c.id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}

SELECT c.id AS id, c.username AS username FROM PUBLIC.INGREDIENT AS i LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.CANDYBAR_INGREDIENT AS ci ON i.id = ci.INGREDIENTS_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.CANDYBAR AS c ON c.id = ci.CANDYBAR_ID WHERE 1=1 AND i.id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
